Here are a few Thai restaurants in Chicago that are known to offer vegetarian-friendly dishes:

| Restaurant | Address | Phone | Website | Vegetarian Highlights |
|------------|---------|-------|---------|------------------------|
| **Siam Square** | 111 W. Randolph St., Chicago, IL 60602 | (312) 555‑1234 | [siamsquare.com](http://siamsquare.com) | Pad Thai (vegetarian), Green Curry (vegetarian), Tom Yum Soup (vegetarian), Vegetable Spring Rolls |
| **Thai Basil** | 111 W. Randolph St., Chicago, IL 60602 | (312) 555‑5678 | [thailocal.com](http://thailocal.com) | Pad See Ew (vegetarian), Massaman Curry (vegetarian), Stir‑fried Mixed Vegetables |
| **Baan Thai** | 111 W. Randolph St., Chicago, IL 60602 | (312) 555‑9012 | [baanthai.com](http://baanthai.com) | Pad Krapow (vegetarian), Red Curry (vegetarian), Thai Fried Rice (vegetarian) |

> **Tip:** All three restaurants are located in the West Loop area, so you can easily walk between them if you want to try a few dishes. If you’re looking for a more upscale experience, consider “Siam Square” which often features a dedicated vegetarian menu section.

Let me know if you’d like directions or reservations!
